_doc: The shared rarity ladder (item-database.md rule 7, Formulas A): rarity = kind_rank + kind_offset[kind], clamped to 1..rarity_max. kind_rank: herb and treasure their template rarity, material its template rarity, artifact its grade (0-4), cong_phap (a manual) its tier (0-3), pill its price band, talisman its material_rarity. Lost-item decay (rule 14): an ordinary item Lost at a place, untouched, for lost_decay_years is removed; named, bound and reserved items, and items at rarity lost_decay_rarity_max or above, never decay.
